messages:
sara_csm: Morning — heads up: Nimbuslytics onboarding looks healthy on volume but we're seeing intermittent tail latency on /generate when users upload large docs. P95 ~1.2-1.3s during peak windows, renewal in ~55d so want a proactive plan.

devin_eng: Got it. Do we have token distribution and example workloads? Long-doc summarization vs chat?

sara_csm: Mostly long-doc summarization. Last 48h: 18k requests, median tokens 900, mean 1500, ~32% >1500 tokens. Errors are clustered during 11am-1pm UTC.

pat_sre: Two quick hedges: 1) route >1500 token requests to dedicated eu-west pool for better KV cache locality; 2) canary model-swap to compact-v2-int8 for long-context summarizations. Keeps latency and cost in check.

lia_support: Customer also reported ~6 504s yesterday (ticket #4581). Stack shows queued requests at the edge during the same windows. I attached trimmed traces to the ticket.

sara_csm: Proposed rollout: a) add a routed path for summarization with estimated-tokens header, b) canary split 15% to compact-v2-int8 for summarization only, c) enable prefix KV cache TTL=45m for summarization pipelines, d) run a 24h quality check against our evaluation set, rollback if degradation >3% (ROUGE).

devin_eng: Config we can push via Console routes UI: 

```yaml
- name: nimbus-summarize-longseq
  match: "/generate"
  conditions:
    - header: X-Workload-Type
      eq: summarization
    - header: X-Estimated-Tokens
      gt: "1500"
  model: redwood/compact-v2-int8
  split: 0.15
  fallback: redwood/compact-v2-fp16
  kv_cache_ttl: 2700  # seconds (45m)
```

pat_sre: I'll create a capacity reservation on eu-west dedicated nodes and an autoscale floor for the summarization route. Also adding an early-reject timeout at the edge: if total processing >10s return 429 with body suggesting smaller chunking. We should notify the customer before turning that on.

lia_support: Agreed. I'll draft the customer-facing note: explain what's changing, expected perf/cost tradeoffs, invite them to a short call and offer to run a curated batch of 200 of their historical requests through the compact model to show quality delta.

sara_csm: Perfect. Ops checklist: 1) dev pushes route to staging (devin), 2) pat reserves capacity and configures early-reject, 3) run A/B on 200 samples (devin + lia), 4) monitor dashboard for latency, error rate, and quality. If quality delta <=3% proceed to prod canary 15% for 48h, then consider ramp.

devin_eng: I'll run the A/B tomorrow morning and paste results here. If we see unexpected diffs we'll tighten split to 5% and extend evaluation.

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: Nimbuslytics performance sync — today 16:30 UTC. Invite sent to participants. :calendar:
